title: Seacrest Beach "Pool Envy" 170 Seacrest Beach Boulevard East
h1: Seacrest Beach "Pool Envy" 170 Seacrest Beach Boulevard East
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Walking distance to the beach- Private heated pool **Pool heating available October 1-May 1 for $30 per day**- Professionally decorated- Connected to a large green space (perfect for outdoor activities)- 5 adult bikes provided- Access to the pool cafe- Neighborhood tram that run between the pool and the beach- Outdoor kitchen and entertaining area on the third-floor deck- Grill - Multiple dedicated parking spots- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkoutPlease note this community requires a Guest Registration Form to be completed within two weeks of arrival to access the community amenitiesDETAILS: "Pool Envy" is a custom-built, 5-bedroom, luxury home designed with fun and relaxation in mind. Conveniently located in popular Seacrest, this dream home has easy access to many beach communities, including Alys Beach and Rosemary. In addition to having the largest, private, heated pool in Seacrest, you are steps away from the popular 12,000 square foot community lagoon pool. "Pool Envy" is situated at the front of the community, just a few short minutes from the beach, as well as countless dining options within walking or biking distance.This stunning home boasts inviting, coastal decor with no detail left forgotten. Top-of-the-line finishes, stainless appliances, and hardwood floors are just a few of the details that will create an upscale feel with all the conveniences of home. This spacious home that sleeps 12 includes two primary suites with king beds, two guest rooms with king beds, and a bunk room that sleeps four, all with private bathrooms. This family-friendly home has a third floor designed for entertainment. With a separate family room equipped with games, you can step outside onto a fabulous deck that includes a convenient outdoor kitchen. Enjoy the view of the private pool while relaxing or reading on the custom swing. During your stay in this luxury beach home, you will enjoy the comforts of endless amenities. Whether it is swimming in your own private pool, enjoying a ride on the complimentary bikes, or simply relaxing in the breathtaking luxury of a comfortable, professionally decorated space, "Pool Envy" is the perfect beach vacation.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 12):FIRST FLOOR:-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only-Half Bathroom- Toilet OnlySECOND FLOOR: -Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo-Bunk Room: Two Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboTHIRD FLOOR:-Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only-Half Bathroom- Toilet Only*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.*The propane grill by the pool is for guest use. However, the gas grill on the 3rd-floor patio is for the owner's use only.*We are happy to welcome up to 2 dogs, not to exceed the weight limit of 30lbs for an additional non-refundable pet fee of $400, plus tax.
